spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the decision table of the last reset's world. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `unanswered`: nothing did, and the command answered `501`.

spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.title: ExternalAnswer
spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.description: One external cause a served command asked about, and what answered it.

outcome.description: The outcome whose cause was asked about, as the command declares it.

holds.description: Whether the cause holds; absent when nothing answered it.
